title: Internal reminder — periodic reminders for pending human tasks
description: Demonstrates the reminder mechanism. After the agent completes validation, the workflow pauses for human approval with remind_after_seconds=30. If the human does not respond within 30 seconds, AXME sends a reminder email. Reminders repeat every 30 seconds up to max_reminders=3.

human_task.title: Change review — payments-processor config update
human_task.description: Review the validation results and approve or reject the configuration change. Reminders will be sent every 30 seconds.
